name: listenhub
conclusion_quantitative: listenhub (Ask) specifies 3 of 5 categories: 2 autonomy limits, 1 clarification rule, 5 approval gates; none for validation rules, escalation rules. Strongest: approval gates.
conclusion_qualitative: listenhub turns ideas into podcasts, explainer videos, narration or images through ListenHub scripts. The agent mostly acts on its own, picking modes and defaults without asking when a request is short or ambiguous, and asks only about the format when it is unclear. Its firm gates are human review of a two-stage podcast script before audio is made and confirmation before rewriting an image prompt. It sets no checks on its own work and no rules for handling failure.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 2 autonomy limits (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, 1 tied to a situation, both in running text. When the user only gives a topic, the agent creates a single-speaker podcast without further clarification, and when a speech request is ambiguous it applies defaults instead of asking.

statements.quote: create a single-speaker podcast without further clarification.
When the request is ambiguous (e.g., "convert to speech", "read aloud"), apply:

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 1 clarification rule (0 mandatory, 1 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There is one rule, counted as a suggestion (it contains "prefer"), tied to a situation, in running text. If it is unclear which format the user wants, the agent asks.

statements.quote: **Default**: If unclear, ask user which format they prefer.

approval_gates.conclusion_quantitative: 5 approval gates (5 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There are 5 rules, all strict, none tied to a situation, mostly running text. In two-stage podcast generation the agent must stop after the script is generated and wait for the user's explicit approval before producing audio, never skipping that review. It asks before enriching a short image prompt and never optimizes a prompt without confirmation.

statements.quote: **The entire value of two-stage generation is human review between stages. Skipping review reduces it to one-stage with extra latency — never do this.**
**Review Gate (mandatory)**: After text generation completes, the agent MUST:
**STOP and wait for explicit user approval** before proceeding to Stage 2.
The agent MUST NOT proceed to Stage 2 automatically. This is a hard constraint, not a suggestion.
In this case, ask whether the user would like help enriching the prompt. Do not optimize without confirmation.

validation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to check its own work, such as running tests, or says when the work counts as done.

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
